QuestInfo.name: Preparing for Their Arrival
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra says she needs your help.
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra has asked you to bring a weapon from the town Weapons Shop for the heroes who will be reviving soon.
QuestInfo.2: The weapon you brought will be used by the legendary Arans. Isn't that exciting?

0.0: The heroes will soon revive, and they'll need a number of things then. Don't you think so?

yes.0: Yes, I'm talking about something they can use as a weapon...Like a Pole Arm or something. Their critical hit consists of a series of consecutive attacks which includes waving around a Pole Arm. They'll need a lot of weapons when they revive.
yes.1: Please find a #bPole Arm#k that the heroes can use. You can probably get one from the town Weapons Shop.

item.0: You can easily acquire a #bPole Arm#k from the town Weapons Shop.
